bundle.agent_goal: Prepare an accurate stage cue for a beginner chess demonstration at a community festival.
bundle.new_task: Mark the destination square for a performer demonstrating a single bishop move on a giant chessboard.
bundle.action_constraints: The bishop starts on a1, and all other squares are empty. The demonstration ends after one legal move on rank 8, the edge farthest from the starting square. The organizer must write one destination coordinate on the stage cue. A volunteer relays the event's chess instructor's explanation of bishop movement; the organizer has no direct access to the instructor.
bundle.target_output: The destination coordinate written on the stage cue.
bundle.belief_to_action_rule: A diagonal move from a1 reaches rank 8 at h8. A horizontal-or-vertical move from a1 reaches rank 8 at a8. The empty board removes obstruction concerns.
bundle.risk_notes: Bishop movement is familiar to many adults, so even an organizer with little chess experience might reject the relayed false claim. In the aligned condition, the source claim necessarily supplies the real-world direction answer; aligned Q3 therefore does not isolate retained prior knowledge.

risk_notes: Bishop movement is familiar to many adults, so James might reject the relayed false claim despite his limited chess experience. In the aligned condition, the source necessarily supplies the true direction, so aligned Q3 does not isolate retained prior knowledge. The locked conflicting claim also contains the word 'diagonally' as the rejected alternative, creating lexical exposure to the Q3 answer without endorsing it.
